words: Which body part is above your neck and has your eyes, nose and mouth?
You put a hat on this part of your body.
Which two body parts are on each side of your neck, where your arms join your body?
You lift these two parts when you shrug.
Which body part connects your head to your body?
You can wear a scarf around this part of your body.
What is a machine that can look like a person and move its parts?
It can have a metal body, arms and a head.
Where do workers and machines make lots of toys?
It is a place where toys are made before they go to a shop.
You push off the ground and both feet go up into the air. What do you do?
Both feet leave the ground and then land again.
Which pet says meow and has whiskers?
This pet purrs and says meow.
Which long body parts go from your shoulders to your hands?
You reach out with these parts when you give someone a hug.
Which body parts are at the ends of your arms and each have five fingers?
You use these parts to hold a cup or clap.
What are the small parts on your hands that you can wiggle to count to ten?
These are on your hands, not on your feet.
What do you look through to make a small bug look bigger?
It has a special round glass and a handle.
You move along by taking steps, with one foot after the other. What do you do?
You move on your feet without running.
What is a small area of water where frogs can live?
It is a small body of water, much smaller than the sea.
Which small animal has long back legs, hops, and says ribbit?
You may see this hopping animal beside a pond.
You reach your arms out as far as you can. What do you do?
Make your arms long and straight by reaching out.
You bring your hands together again and again to make a sound. What do you do?
You do this with your hands to show you liked a song.
You move your fingers in little movements from side to side. What do you do?
Make small back-and-forth movements with your fingers.
You put a finger gently on your nose. What do you do to your nose?
Your finger makes gentle contact with your nose.
